descriptions.zh:
初步报告显示§Y[From.GetName]§!上的海洋从某种程度上来说居然是活的，其中包含着一种我们从来都没见过的外星实体。

我们应当建立一座低轨研究前哨来研究将这片活体海洋。我们预期可以获得进展。
descriptions.en:
Preliminary reports suggest the ocean covering §Y[From.GetName]§! is somehow alive, comprising an alien entity unlike any we've encountered before.

We should establish a low-orbit research outpost to study the living sea. Updates are to be expected.

descriptions.zh: 研究居住在三个相连星系中的垃圾堆隧道里的奇特智慧生物，或许可以更加了解这个曾经拥有这些星球的星际文明。
descriptions.en: Studying the strange sapients that live in tunnels in the junk heaps of three linked systems might yield insight into the lost interstellar civilization that once ruled these worlds.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过§HL-星门§!到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。

这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
descriptions.en:
We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through §HL-Gates§!, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for now we lack the necessary insight into the subspace mechanics that govern their use to lift the lockdown.

descriptions.zh: 一个早已消逝的外星物种的巨型世代舰船，其导航设备中可能藏有一颗完美星球的坐标。
descriptions.en: A massive generation ship belonging to a long dead race of aliens may hold the encrypted location of a utopian planet within its navigational drive.

descriptions.zh: 我们的母星周围最近出现了负相物质。这种奇怪的现象肯定不是动摇我们社会根基的事情的预兆。
descriptions.en: Negative Mass has recently appeared around our homeworld. The strange phenomenon surely won't be a herald of something that will shake our society's very core.
